stops.note: a Danish village name combining 'kvissel' (cleft branch) and 'mark' (borderland)
Latinized surname adopted by an ancestor of Vidkun Quisling, after the place name
coined after Vidkun Quisling, who headed Norway's Nazi puppet government
stops.meaning: a traitor who collaborates with an occupying enemy

current_meaning: a traitor who collaborates with an occupying enemy force
